experiment: One synchronous Unity CLI C# invocation in the same Editor after the test
state: EditMode idle, not the PlayMode test window
interpretation: This idle-Editor observation did not detect the intentional allocation. It does not establish that CanProceed is allocation-free or that every PlayMode measurement is unsupported.
